translations.translatedText: # Friday 8.4.2022 (radio)
Zelenskyy in Parliament. Russia sanctions. Airspace violation. Expulsions from the embassy. Mistreatment of older people. Weather.
## Zelenskyy in Parliament

![Bearded Zelenskyy waves his hand on a video screen in the parliament chamber. He wears a green t-shirt.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4252,h_2391,x_0,y_391/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-9400096250239928389/1649419306)
Open image viewer
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy spoke to the Finnish Parliament via video link. Photo: Kimmo Brandt / EPA
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has spoken today to Finnish MPs.

The Ukrainian President told Parliament by video that Ukraine no longer has time to wait for help. Zelenskyy said that hundreds of Ukrainians die every day. Already 10 million have had to leave their homes.
Zelenskyy thanked Finland for also giving Ukraine military support at the start of the war.
Zelenskyy also said that Finns saved Finland from Stalin's attack in the Winter War. Likewise, Ukraine is now fighting against the invader.
The Ukrainian President asked the rest of the world to stop importing oil and gas from Russia, because Russia gets money for the war from them.
Zelenskyy said that hatred must disappear, and peace and freedom will win.
## Sanctions

![The blue and yellow flag of the European Union flutters in Strasbourg, France.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_3500,h_1969,x_0,y_159/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-8404716112aaf11ac91/1710352827)
Open image viewer
Photo: Patrick Seeger / EPA
The EU countries have decided on new sanctions against Russia.
The sanctions concern, among other things, Russian oligarchs, that is, business tycoons, as well as propaganda agents and representatives of the armed forces.
In addition, funds of several Russian banks will be frozen and coal imports banned. Ships flying the Russian flag will also be banned from entering ports.
## Airspace violation
![Sky](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11655882)
Open image viewer
The aircraft suspected of the violation was an IL-96-300. It is a long-haul passenger aircraft owned by the Russian state. Photo: Eleni Paspatis / Yle
A Russian state aircraft violated Finland's airspace in the morning. The suspected violation took place off Porvoo in the Gulf of Finland.
The suspected airspace violation lasted three minutes.
The Border Guard has started a preliminary investigation into the case.
Denial-of-service attacks were made on the websites of the Ministry of Defence and the Ministry for Foreign Affairs. The sites could not be reached at all, or only now and then.
The attack began shortly before President Zelenskyy's speech to the Finnish Parliament at 12 o'clock and lasted about an hour.
## Expulsions
![Gate of the Russian embassy.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4336,h_2439,x_0,y_566/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-9400746250358b7596d/1649423847)
Open image viewer
The Russian embassy on Tehtaankatu in Helsinki. Photo: Vesa Moilanen / Lehtikuva
Finland is expelling 2 employees of the Russian embassy from the country and refusing to extend one employee's visa.
The measures were decided at a meeting of the President and the Foreign and Security Policy Ministerial Committee.
In addition, Russian and Belarusian lorry transports can no longer get into Finland.
## Mistreatment

![Emergency medical technicians bring a client to hospital.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6240,h_3510,x_0,y_130/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-8609616156878898de8/1709557890)
Open image viewer
Emergency medical technicians bring a client to hospital. The study examined mistreatment from the perspective of emergency medical technicians. Photo: Toni Pitkänen / Yle
Mistreatment of older people has increased. The study examined mistreatment from the perspective of emergency medical technicians.
56 percent of emergency medical technicians have seen mistreatment of older people.
Typical cases relate to basic needs. These include hygiene, cleanliness of the home and food. Often, care is also poor.
## The weather
![Finland's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12397966)
Open image viewer
Photo: Yle
In the southern and central parts of the country there will be sleet or snow showers on Saturday. The sun may also show. In Lapland the sleet is more continuous.
The temperature is between 0 and +5 degrees.
Sleet and snow showers will also continue on Sunday.
